text.en:
The name of the Labakid Elementary School in Barangay Labakid, Municipality of Sindangan,
Province of Zamboanga del Norte, is hereby changed to Apolonio Molina Elementary School.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: March 25, 1982
